certificates.title: Certificates
certificates.myLead: Your certificates and those of children you manage. Download a PDF or prepare a shareable image with the FOA logo when the PDF is ready.
certificates.adminLead: Review issued certificates, correct recipient details, revoke a certificate, or retry a PDF that failed to render.
certificates.verifyLead: Scan the QR code on your certificate or enter its number below to check its validity.
certificates.unknownLead: No certificate matches that number. Check the spelling on the certificate and try again.
certificates.revokedLead: This certificate is no longer valid.
certificates.approvedService: Approved service: {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}} {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}
certificates.shareQueued: Your share image is being prepared. Refresh this page in a moment.
certificates.shareUnavailable: This share image is not available.
certificates.correctionHelp: Either action permanently invalidates the old number. Reissuing changes the printed recipient name, not the approved recognition, and gives the replacement a new number.
certificates.revokedSuccess: Certificate revoked. Its number is no longer valid.
certificates.reissuedSuccess: Certificate reissued with a new number. The previous number is no longer valid.
certificates.correctionError: The certificate could not be corrected. Check the reason and recipient name, or refresh the list.

archive.title: Student certificates
archive.lead: Download one private ZIP of the valid certificates issued to this institution’s students for this competition.
archive.count: {ready} of {total} valid certificates have a ready PDF.
archive.none: No certificates have been issued yet.
archive.waiting: All issued certificate PDFs must be ready before the ZIP can be prepared.
archive.pending: The ZIP is being prepared in the background. Check again shortly.
archive.ready: The ZIP is ready. It is available for up to 24 hours after requesting it.
archive.failed: The ZIP could not be prepared. You can try again.
archive.error: The ZIP could not be requested. Refresh this page and try again.
archive.tooLarge: This ZIP is too large to prepare. Contact FOA for help.
